titles.native: キン肉マン 完璧超人始祖編

description:
A new Kinnikuman series to celebrate the 40th anniversary of the original TV anime. Adapts the Perfect Origin Arc from the Manga.

Kinnikuman returns to the ring in an epic three-way battle between the Justice, Devil and Perfect Chojin factions, and reveals the roots of the Chojin.

(Source: Netflix)

Note: Includes Episode 0.
